title: NHI testing us at missile fields
summary: Salvatore Pais tells of NHI testing us at missile fields, about unspecified at nuclear missile fields, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
plain: A Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, talks about non-human intelligence, meaning beings that are not human, showing up at nuclear missile fields, the places where nuclear missiles are kept ready to launch. "Of course, they're testing us," Pais says. If true, it would mean someone else is watching how humanity handles its most dangerous weapons.
